detail: executeBytecode returned {type:'value'} whose value is undefined, which EvalResult declares impossible
note: OpCode.DUP was the only stack opcode in vm/VM.ts not going through safePop(): it did stack.push(stack[stack.length - 1]). On an empty stack that pushed undefined, and the fallback return handed back {type:'value', value: undefined}, a shape EvalResult declares impossible, so the TypeError landed in the HOST's code rather than the engine's. Reachable only through the public ./vm export, since MatrixIndexParselet only emits DUP after a parsed expression. Fixed in vm/VM.ts by reading through safePop() and pushing twice. This entry is what stops it coming back.
